name: Wire-Tech
old_description: Wire Tech has been making components for handgun and rifles since 1996. What constitutes a good firearm? We agree with most owners who say a firearm that is manufactured with quality workmanship would produce the one needed ingredient: reliability. This is something that WireTech strides to achieve with every job, customer and commitment.
about:
Wire Tech LLC operates from Watertown, Connecticut, where it has been producing precision components since 1996. The company began by making parts for handguns and rifles, establishing a reputation for reliability in small-arms manufacturing.

The shop specializes in wire EDM, sinker EDM, and fast-hole drilling, supported by CNC milling, grinding, and heat-treating in a fully equipped tool room. Its machine lineup includes multiple Mitsubishi wire EDMs (FX10, FA-V, FX20K, FX-10K, FA-10V), a Sodick ALN600G and MV1200R, a CNC Ct300 fast-hole driller, and an EX-8 sinker EDM. Work ranges from single prototypes to full production runs, with programming handled by experienced tool and die makers using ESPRIT CAM software.

Wire Tech serves the medical, firearms, aerospace, automotive, aircraft, electronics, instrumentation, and molding industries. Customers include manufacturers of surgical instruments, firearm components, aerospace fixtures, and progressive stamping dies. The company also builds assembly tools, test fixtures, and welding fixtures for these sectors.

The company emphasizes that its programming and setups are performed by diemakers who understand part function and clearances, allowing computerized monitoring to catch deviations early. It offers 24-hour emergency service, retains all job data for exact repeat orders, and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.
